title: Pruning n8n execution data is the n8n demo: the invoice decision history must still be intact afterwards
content:
The n8n integration is the least exotic in the corpus: an HTTP Request node posting a typed mutation on each branch of the workflow. No plugin, no SDK, no custom node — the node that already exists is enough, which makes this the cheapest demo to stand up of any tool cohort in this slice.

The demonstration is the destructive step. Prune n8n's execution data, then show the invoice's decision history still intact and replayable from Powerhouse. The reason that step is persuasive rather than contrived is recorded in the paired fit finding for the same seven leads: n8n's execution pruning is on by default, so the demo does not stage an unusual failure, it performs the product's normal behaviour and shows what is lost.

Seven leads carry this demo and all seven are German — Stuttgart (two), Karlsruhe, Wiesbaden, Hamburg, Hamburg/Berlin and one with an unverified HQ. One is at "1 · start here" and six at "3 · later". A single-geography cohort with a zero-code integration point is a reasonable candidate for one reference build shown to all of them.
